He says he ONLY filed the report so he could make an insurance claim on the jewelry.

source_caption_text:
Nems (Gorilla Nems) is finally speaking out about the chain incident and addressing the conversations that have been circulating.

According to Nems, the decision to file a police report wasn’t about trying to get anyone in trouble or take things further than necessary. He says he ONLY filed the report so he could make an insurance claim on the jewelry.

Now, he’s setting the record straight and giving his side of the story, making it clear what his intentions were from the beginning. With so much speculation surrounding the situation, his explanation adds another layer to a story that has clearly caught people’s attention.
